title: Unresponsive person
text: Check the scene is safe, then tap the shoulders and shout: are you okay?
Call for the crew medical officer and put the emergency call out on the loop.
Open the airway with head tilt, chin lift; look, listen and feel for breathing for no more than 10 seconds.
If breathing normally, place in the recovery position and monitor. If not breathing normally, start CPR immediately.

citations.source: American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED guidance: unresponsive person assessment sequence.
